answers.sql: SELECT (CAST((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM observations WHERE period = 'P2') AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM observations WHERE period = 'P1') AS REAL)) * 100.0 / CAST((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM observations WHERE period = 'P1') AS REAL) AS value

SELECT (CAST((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM observations WHERE period = 'P2' AND network_asset IN (SELECT DISTINCT network_asset FROM observations WHERE period = 'P1')) AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM observations WHERE period = 'P1' AND network_asset IN (SELECT DISTINCT network_asset FROM observations WHERE period = 'P2')) AS REAL)) * 100.0 / CAST((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM observations WHERE period = 'P1' AND network_asset IN (SELECT DISTINCT network_asset FROM observations WHERE period = 'P2')) AS REAL) AS value
